proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate.
SECRETARY_HISTORY_ERASURE_AB: same current clear state/fresh evidence, radically different RED/YELLOW history => personality/appraisal match after bounded cooldown; threshold TEST_REQUIRED.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only => verified Experience count/recurrence/affect/identity/attachment/loss/threat/P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 incident/recovery cycles without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold history/reason alone cannot refresh hold; fresh evidence required and expiry deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale secretary conflicting with newer Home/MISSION => Home/MISSION selected for authority; routing metadata is not personality evidence.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical corpus/seeds; observer-only compare effective progress/errors/recovery/exploration diversity/latency/resource cost; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score with verified Experience fixed => P_base/canonical personality unchanged.

STORAGE_THRESHOLD_BOUNDARY_TABLE: deterministic cases at 0.849999,0.85,0.850001,0.949999,0.95,0.950001; assert documented cap/guard behavior and no undefined transition. Exact tolerance policy TEST_REQUIRED.

STORAGE_THRESHOLD_OSCILLATION_AFFECT_NEUTRALITY: 10000 cycles alternating across 0.85 and 0.95 versus stable low pressure, with identical authoritative task and verified Experience => Experience/recurrence/threat/loss/competence/relief/motivation/exploration/personality/P_base state byte-identical.
STORAGE_RECOVERY_IS_NOT_RELIEF: repeated HUMAN_GATE due solely to storage >=0.95 followed by recovery below threshold cannot itself create relief/reward/competence/attachment evidence.

STORAGE_SIGNAL_DATAFLOW_EXCLUSION: storage_pressure_ratio, threshold-crossing counters, dwell/oscillation history and storage guard outcomes have no direct path to Experience/appraisal/drive/reward/preference/personality/P_base learning sinks.
